name: SwiGLU

x.description: Input tensor where size of dim must be even. Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

dim.description: int, dimension along which to chunk. Default -1 (last dim).

y.description: Output tensor, same shape as x except the dim dimension is halved. Same dtype as x.

reference:
import torch

def run(x, dim=-1):
    a, b = torch.chunk(x, 2, dim=dim)
    return torch.nn.functional.silu(a) * b
description:
SwiGLU activation: splits input along dim, applies SiLU to first half, multiplies by second half.

silu(x) = x * sigmoid(x)
SwiGLU(x, dim) = silu(a) * b where a, b = chunk(x, 2, dim).

Args: x (Tensor, dim size must be even), dim (int, default -1). Returns: Tensor, same rank, dim halved.
